game_concept: A tower defense set in Mystic Forest – Glowing Heartwood, the glowing ancient tree: the forest ranger must handle shadow wolves while practicing control flow: for loops. Core idea – Range Runner: Run a for i in range(n) loop so the forest ranger moves exactly n steps toward the spirit shrine.
theme: Mystic Forest – Glowing Heartwood: the glowing ancient tree
core_gameplay_loop: In Glowing Heartwood, repeat each round: Run a for i in range(n) loop so the forest ranger moves exactly n steps toward the spirit shrine. Each round, shadow wolves strike the spirit shrine, so respond before the next strike lands. Then check the steps_left value and advance.
secondary_mechanics: Hint tokens that reveal one line of code
player_objective: Protect the spirit shrine from shadow wolves in Glowing Heartwood: keep the steps_left meter above zero by applying the concept correctly until the 42-second timer ends.
controls: Mouse/touch: drag code blocks into the editor panel; SPACE runs the code; keys 1-4 pick answers.
lose_condition: steps_left drops to 0, or lives reach 0, before the 42-second timer ends.
learning_alignment: Week 5 – Control Flow: For Loops | Level 1 (intro tier): Range Runner
assets_style: lush pixel-art forest: dense green canopy, a glowing blue ancient tree, winding streams and dirt paths; flat Kenney-style sprites; airy flutes, birdsong and soft magical chimes
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Range Runner' (Week 5 slot 1), mission type 'Survival Siege', and setting 'Glowing Heartwood'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Mystic Forest

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how steps_left changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against shadow wolves in Glowing Heartwood.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: Timer reaches 42 seconds while steps_left > 0.
